response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer, but his profile does not match this role's mandatory requirements. His C++ experience is limited to a brief ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a thesis project, falling far short of 5–10 years of hands-on Windows C++ development. He has no Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience (RIDE Capital is a fintech startup, not capital markets), and no demonstrated SQL Server/Oracle depth. His strengths lie in TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and web platforms, which are largely irrelevant here.
strengths: Deep low-latency systems experience (DLang, async I/O, high-throughput microservices)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, testing frameworks
Broad polyglot background with some C/C++ and Java exposure
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++ experience, and not on Windows financial systems
No Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain knowledge
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle experience; skills list only generic SQL/MySQL/MongoDB

key_factors.factor: Missing capital markets / fixed income domain
Strong general engineering and performance background
